cases.reviewer: partly: Daily present, absent, late and late minutes work, but the monthly summary is factory-wide counts only, with no per-employee totals, and there is no employee list, so names are retyped every day.
cases.request: Employee attendance system for my factory with daily present or absent, late marks and a monthly summary

spec.name: Factory Attendance
spec.description: Daily attendance tracking with present, absent, late marks, and monthly summaries for factory employees.

children.label: Present Today
children.expr: count(filter(attendance, shift_date == today && (status == 'Present' || status == 'Late' || status == 'Half Day')))

children.label: Total Present Records
children.expr: count(filter(attendance, month(shift_date) == month(today) && (status == 'Present' || status == 'Late' || status == 'Half Day')))

delete_entry.confirm: Are you sure you want to remove this attendance record?

meta.description: Daily attendance tracking with present, absent, late marks, and monthly summaries for factory employees.
